import sys

def largest_power(N):
    # changing all right side bits to 1.
    N = N | (N >> 1)
    N = N | (N >> 2)
    N = N | (N >> 4)
    N = N | (N >> 8)
    N = N | (N >> 16)
    N = N | (N >> 32)
    return (N + 1) >> 1

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    z = input_data[1]
    ans = [0, 0]
    k = 0
    count = 0
    for i in range(n):
        ch = z[i]
        if ch == '_':
            if count > ans[k] and k == 0:
                ans[k] = count
            elif k == 1:
                if count > 0:
                    ans[k] += 1
            count = 0
        elif ch == '(':
            k = 1
            if count > ans[0]:
                ans[0] = count
            count = 0
        elif ch == ')':
            k = 0
            if count > 0:
                ans[1] += 1
            count = 0
        else:
            count += 1
    if count > ans[0] and k == 0:
        ans[0] = count
    print(f"{ans[0]} {ans[1]}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
